answer: Guard paid work with a ridge test no farm can pass twice. A newcomer locks a 3,750 POA ridge bond and submits its first job through two independent review channels, one on each side of the ridge, neither seeing the other's verdict. A mirror check compares both submissions: if they diverge, or two identities submit matching work, the bond burns and both are barred for three years, so one hundred fakes risk 375,000 POA. A sable courier carrying one real delivery crosses the ridge once and keeps its record; a farm's reflections shatter the first time they are compared.
